title: Records moved from 38.31, with and without their own times, on one day (decision I5)
story: A 38.31 copy, last saved Tue 24 Nov 2026 at 08:00, is moved that morning. Its bank figure of 300,000 was typed on Sun 22 Nov at 18:00 (it has its own time), so the bank opens on 22 Nov, told at 18:00. Its receipts: 4,000 on Sat 21 Nov with no time; on 22 Nov, 2,000 at 12:00, 5,000 with no time and 1,000 at 20:00; 3,000 on Mon 23 Nov with no time. On Wed 25 Nov the person checks the bank: 290,000. I5: a moved record's told is its own time if it has one, else the copy's last saved time; on one day they keep the old list order. So the 12:00 receipt is inside the 18:00 figure; the 20:00 one and the one with no time (told at the save, 24 Nov 08:00) come after it. The order of the receipts among themselves changes no figure. No holidays are listed. Every amount is made up.

events.note: receipt, no time: told at the copy's last save
receipt with its own time, after the figure

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 300,000 (bank figure 22 Nov at 18:00) - 5,000 (22 Nov, no time: told at the save, 24 Nov 08:00, so after the figure) - 1,000 (22 Nov at 20:00) - 3,000 (23 Nov) = 291,000
asks.note: The 21 Nov 4,000 is before the figure's day and the 22 Nov 2,000 at 12:00 is before its time: both are inside it. Before I5 the model read every moved receipt on 22 Nov as inside the figure: 297,000.

asks.question: not_explained
asks.why: 291,000 (what the events say at the 25 Nov check) - 290,000 (the check) = 1,000
